note.text: Most AI deployments are built like one-way doors: easy to walk through, impossible to walk back out of. A system that can only run forward, never be unwound, isn't resilient, it's a dependency with good PR. The real test of a mature AI architecture isn't how fast it onboards a new process, it's how cleanly it lets a team, a customer, or a dataset withdraw from it without the whole structure buckling. Build the exit before you build the entrance, or the exit will build itself at the worst possible moment.
